'''Lead''' was a heavy metallic element used in [[Armor/Legends|armor]], particularly those of the [[Radiation zone assault trooper|radiation trooper]] who used it as a lead-polymer substrate against contamination while in contact with [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] over a long period of time.
